commands.name: list
commands.description: List handoffs. Defaults to the current branch. Pass --all to list across active branches or --include-deleted to include deleted local branches.

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete one handoff by exact slug.

commands.name: gc
commands.description: Delete handoffs whose local branch no longer exists.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create one handoff artifact from final Markdown supplied on stdin or with --file.
